brief_item.title: Qwen-CUA用截图折叠和大规模Rollout推进电脑操作Agent
brief_item.direction_name: GPU集群、分布式训练与工程可靠性
brief_item.core_conclusion: Qwen-CUA让397B-A17B MoE模型仅依赖截图并输出键鼠事件，不调用DOM、无障碍树或Shell接口。系统保留20张活动截图，旧图按每10张一组折叠，控制长轨迹上下文并保留稳定前缀。
brief_item.mechanism: 训练侧用可验证环境、轨迹切片、结果奖励和迭代SFT/RL刷新数据，Rollout集群接近10万vCPU并运行数万并发环境。上下文侧保留近期像素与可复用前缀，减少视觉历史增长。
brief_item.result: Qwen-CUA在OSWorld-Verified得分86.2，高于Qwen3.7的73.3。OSWorld 2.0二元和部分完成率为18.5%和48.4%，RedTeamCUA攻击成功率16.4，Qwen-CUA-Max达到87.6。
brief_item.boundary: 论文没有给出单任务时延、Rollout成本、GPU利用率或训练算力。截图协议牺牲隐藏DOM和无障碍状态，基准分数也不能直接代表专有软件的部署可靠性。
brief_item.project_relevance: 视觉上下文管理可作为Agent运行时效率问题，需记录活动上下文、KV复用、环境吞吐和轨迹长度。应比较截图与混合工具成本，不能只看准确率。

facts.title: Qwen-CUA: Native Computer Use for (almost) Everything
facts.event_hint: Qwen-CUA screenshot-only computer-use agent with scalable verifiable interaction
facts.problem: Operating desktop, legacy, web, and professional software through screenshots requires long-horizon state tracking, costly interactive experience, and reliable rewards despite sparse final-state supervision. A growing visual history can also exceed context budgets and reduce reusable prompt prefixes.
facts.mechanism: Qwen-CUA uses a 397B-A17B MoE backbone that observes screenshots and emits keyboard/mouse events without DOM, accessibility, shell, or task APIs. Its scaffold retains up to 20 active screenshots and folds older visual history in deterministic blocks of ten, preserving recent pixels and stable prefixes. Training scales verifiable rollout environments, trajectory slicing, outcome rewards, and iterative SFT/RL data refreshes.

evidence.claim: Qwen-CUA reaches 86.2 on OSWorld-Verified versus 73.3 for Qwen3.7, and OSWorld 2.0 binary/partial completion of 18.5/48.4 versus 2.5/22.5.
Scaling the recipe to over one trillion total parameters (Qwen-CUA-Max) raises OSWorld-Verified to 87.6 and OSWorld 2.0 binary/partial to 21.2/53.3.
evidence.condition: Qwen-CUA-Max over one trillion total parameters

evidence.claim: Qwen-CUA reduces RedTeamCUA attack success from 36.6 to 16.4 relative to Qwen3.7 while improving task success.
Training uses a rollout fleet with nearly 100,000 vCPUs, tens of thousands of concurrent environments, and approximately 40,000 verifiable tasks.
evidence.condition: Alibaba Cloud ECS rollout and diverse desktop/web environments

evidence.claim: The scaffold retains 20 active screenshots and folds older screenshots in blocks of ten, keeping recent visual evidence while preserving reusable prompt prefixes.
evidence.baseline: Unbounded visual history or per-step folding
evidence.source_locator: PDF pages 2-3, Introduction and Context Management

facts.evaluation_context: Qwen-CUA is evaluated across eight computer-use benchmarks, including OSWorld-Verified, OSWorld 2.0, RedTeamCUA, WebArena, ScienceBoard, MyPCBench, Gym-Anything, and MacAgentBench. The system is trained with a large cloud rollout fleet, verifiable tasks, human/personalized workflows, executable rewards, and iterative supervised/RL data refreshes.
facts.limitations: The excerpt reports benchmark scores and infrastructure scale but not per-task latency, rollout cost, GPU utilization, or exact training compute. Screenshot-only interaction sacrifices hidden DOM/accessibility state and may be less efficient than hybrid tools; Bash augmentation is described as shortening trajectories but without a quantified result in this chunk. Benchmark performance and attack success may not predict deployment reliability on arbitrary proprietary software, and scaling model parameters raises serving cost (inference).
facts.project_relevance: For AI-infrastructure and agent runtime tracking, Qwen-CUA shows that visual context management and stable prefixes are part of systems efficiency: deterministic block folding can bound screenshot tokens while improving KV-cache reuse. The large rollout fleet and verifiable task design also suggest measuring environment throughput, reward freshness, active-context size, cache reuse, trajectory length, and hybrid-tool impact—not just final benchmark accuracy (inference).
